verdict.rationale: Pylon's Support Agent works inside the same tracked issues that humans handle. It can 'gather internal context for your team', and the issue log shows the steps the AI took, which implies a human taking over has the conversation and the AI's collected context. No document describes an explicit escalation handoff that packages a summary and collected details. Missing for 10: documented agent-to-human escalation flow, an auto-generated handoff summary at escalation, structured collected-details transfer, evidence the customer is not re-asked, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, when the agent escalates, the human gets the full conversation, a summary, and collected details — the customer never repeats themselves

citations.quote: Support Agents can deflect customer questions using content, gather internal context for your team, and take action.
The issue log allows you to inspect all the issues the AI agent is associated with and inspect the outcomes and steps taken by the AI.
Pylon lets humans and agents collaborate on customer work
